'''Rannel''' is an [[herbs|herb]] that can be found in the [[Two Rivers]] region. A mixture of rannel and [[sheepstongue root]] will perk a person up somewhat, but the significant property is its horrible and lasting taste. A village [[Wisdom]] such as [[Nynaeve]] may administer the concoction to someone who is claiming they are sick, moping, behaving "like a goose" and generally acting the fool.{{ref/book|2|8}}
